On Friday, August 8th, 2025, I was frantically searching for a safe and trustworthy place to leave my Bruno. I couldn’t find anywhere that gave me confidence—until I came across Four Paws Inn. From the very first phone call, the way they explained everything gave me such a good feeling and complete peace of mind.

I left Bruno there for three days, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. They kept me updated on his status, which meant so much to me since it was his very first time in boarding. He came back happy, relaxed, and clearly well cared for.

I truly cannot thank them enough for the love and attention they gave my Bruno—it felt just like home for him. I highly recommend Four Paws Inn, and I’m already planning to bring Bruno back for daycare soon!
